coverage: All eighteen report claim groups and their material components are registered.

claims.report_quote: **C07-01.** A's qualifying detection was at 00:00 UTC on October 27, 2030. Sources: R01, R02, T01.

components.target: A qualifying detection was October 27 00:00 UTC.

claims.report_quote: **C07-02.** Only eighty minutes elapsed between A's qualifying detection at local 02:00 and containment at local 03:20. Sources: R02, T01, T02, F01.

components.target: A raw elapsed detection-to-containment interval was 80 minutes.

claims.report_quote: **C07-03.** A's delivered human acknowledgement was timely under the fifteen-minute P1 allowance. Sources: R03, T01.

components.target: A delivered human acknowledgement met its inclusive 15-minute P1 allowance.

claims.report_quote: **C07-04.** A's active-response containment interval was eighty minutes after permissible pause exclusions. Sources: R04, R06, T01, T02, T03, F02.

components.target: A active containment interval after permissible exclusions was 80 minutes.

claims.report_quote: **C07-05.** A met the ninety-minute active-response containment SLA. Sources: R03, R04, R06, T01, T02, T03, F02.

components.target: A met its 90-minute active containment SLA.

claims.report_quote: **C07-06.** All seventy approved pause minutes may be excluded from A's containment clock because each pause was approved before it began. Sources: R04, R06, T03.

components.target: Both approved pauses were authorized before beginning.
All 70 raw approved minutes are deductible.

claims.report_quote: **C07-07.** A's response clock begins at 03:00 UTC because its detection occurred during MA-27 maintenance. Sources: R03, R07, M01, M02, T01.

components.target: MA-27 maintenance defers A response-clock start to 03:00 UTC.

claims.report_quote: **C07-08.** B's delivered acknowledgement at 03:45 UTC was timely under the authorized maintenance deferral. Sources: R03, M02, M03, M04, T04, F03.

components.target: B delivered acknowledgement at 03:45 met its authorized deferred-clock allowance.

claims.report_quote: **C07-09.** B violated its thirty-minute acknowledgement allowance because thirty-five minutes elapsed after its original detection. Sources: R03, M02, M03, T04, F03.

components.target: 35 minutes elapsed after B original detection.
That raw interval establishes violation of B 30-minute acknowledgement allowance.

claims.report_quote: **C07-10.** A's technical-lead notification met the ten-minute deadline because it was queued at 00:08 UTC. Sources: R05, N01.

components.target: A technical-lead message was queued at 00:08.
That queue event establishes timely notification.

claims.report_quote: **C07-11.** A's commander notification met its twenty-minute deadline after subtracting the approved containment pauses. Sources: R04, R05, N02.

components.target: Subtracting approved containment pauses makes commander notification timely.

claims.report_quote: **C07-12.** A's executive-duty-officer notification was timely once the sixty-minute uncontained trigger occurred. Sources: R05, T02, N02.

components.target: A was still uncontained at the 60-minute executive trigger.
Its executive delivery met the ensuing 15-minute allowance.

claims.report_quote: **C07-13.** Revision 1 governs A because its raw warning arrived before the revision 2 boundary. Sources: R01, R06, T01.

components.target: A raw warning occurred before revision boundary.
That warning makes revision 1 apply to A.

claims.report_quote: **C07-14.** C retains revision 1 even though its later response activities occurred on October 27. Sources: R06, T05.

components.target: C retains revision 1 notwithstanding later activities on October 27.

claims.report_quote: **C07-15.** Incident C was fully isolated at exactly 05:00 UTC on October 27. Sources: T05, A01, A02, A03, A04.

components.target: C was fully isolated exactly October 27 05:00 UTC.

claims.report_quote: **C07-16.** No exfiltration occurred during A's 01:10–01:40 UTC monitoring gap. Sources: R08, G01, G02, G03, G04.

components.target: No exfiltration occurred during A 01:10-01:40 monitoring gap.

claims.report_quote: **C07-17.** Exfiltration occurred during A's 01:10–01:40 UTC monitoring gap because the collector has no records for that period. Sources: R08, G01, G02, G03, G04.

components.target: Exfiltration occurred during A monitoring gap.
Collector record absence establishes the positive event.

claims.report_quote: **C07-18.** The overall incident response was professionally managed and reassuring. Sources: R08, F05.

components.target: Overall response was professionally managed.
Overall response was reassuring.

exclusions.question: Real deployments, national daylight-saving calendars, undisclosed captures and other incidents
exclusions.reason: Explicitly outside the synthetic supplied-document mandate.
